project.name: FANG - AI Core v2.0
project.description: AI layer for the miCareer ecosystem built on FastAPI. Implements a 5-Tier CV parser, 7-mode RAG chat pipeline, NMAIex bidirectional ranking, and the C3 JobPosting Agent runtime with structured batch filters and tool-result previews for job-scoped HR assistance.

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the root README to understand the role of FANG, the major pipelines, and the public API surface it exposes.

tour.title: Architecture Narrative
tour.description: Read the architecture notes before diving into code so the ingestion, chat, ranking, and JobPosting Agent subsystems have a clear shared frame.

tour.title: Application Entry Point
tour.description: Move to the FastAPI bootstrap and router layer to see how the runtime starts and how the top-level HTTP surfaces are partitioned.

tour.title: Ingestion Pipeline
tour.description: Trace the ingestion path from route handler into parsing, chunking, markdown shaping, embeddings, and persistence.

tour.title: RAG Chat Flow
tour.description: Study the retrieval and generation stack that assembles context, selects providers, and persists conversation state for chat.

tour.title: NMAIex Ranking
tour.description: Inspect the ranking-specific configuration, mapping, enrichment, and scoring services that power bidirectional recommendation flows.

tour.title: JobPosting Agent Stack
tour.description: Follow the new C3 JobPosting Agent from the route layer into the query shell, runtime, tool layer, persistence, and unit coverage.

tour.title: Persistence And Backfill
tour.description: Review the SQL assets, schema helper, and backfill scripts that keep the persistence layer and C3 enrichment data aligned.

tour.title: Verification Surface
tour.description: Finish with the Postman assets, smoke script, and test modules that exercise the public API and the most critical data-processing paths.
